name: Raveness
diceAnatomy: 1-3 = Talon (A), 4-5 = Wing (B), 6 = Raven Eye (C). Vérifié leaflet (photo user 2026-07-06).
source: Board + leaflet + 14 cartes scannés par l'user 2026-07-06. Rulings user : défense = seuils UNE fois ; face 6 du Nevermore Die Roll = pas de soin ; Fowl Friend II = WWW.

tokens.name: Feather
tokens.description: Positive Status Effect. Spend at any time: 1 = force the Nevermore Die Roll to be re-rolled; 2 = +/-1 on the Nevermore Die Roll; 3 = Activate Nevermore.

tokens.name: Hex
tokens.description: Unique Status Effect. 6's are considered blanks: afflicted player treats all die faces showing 6 as completely blank. Removed at the conclusion of their turn. May not be transferred (but can be removed).

tokens.name: Nevermore
tokens.description: Companion. Starts on the Raveness' board with dial at 0. Activated = choose: move to a chosen player, OR Absorb Vitality (only while on an opponent: dial +1 (max 3), that opponent takes 1 isolated undefendable dmg). When moved TO the Raveness: heal the dial amount, then dial to 0. Opponent holding Nevermore rolls the Nevermore Die Roll at their Upkeep: 1 = they gain Hex; 2 = Raveness may Activate x2; 3 = Activate x1; 4 = they discard 1 of choice; 5 = they lose 1 CP, Raveness gains 1 CP; 6 = dial to 0 THEN return to Raveness (NO heal, ruling user).

abilities.notes: On 4-of-a-kind (#'s), Activate Nevermore. Peck II: 6/7/8 dmg et le déclencheur passe à 3-of-a-kind.
Pattern réel : 2 Talons + 2 Raven Eyes (AACC). Activate Nevermore (II : two times). Deal 3 undefendable dmg.
Base : Draw 1, Gain 4 Feather, Activate x2 — aucune attaque. II (WWW, ruling user) : Draw 1, Gain MAX Feather, Activate x3.
Deal 5 & roll 4 (II : 6 & roll 5) : +1 dégât par Talon, +1 Feather par Wing, sur Raven Eye Activate Nevermore.
ULTIMATE. Activate Nevermore three times. Inflict Hex. Deal 13 dmg. (Indéfendable de par la règle Ultimate.)

altAbilities.notes: Alt de Chamber II : Gain 4 Feather. Deal 2 undefendable dmg.
Alt de Beguile II : Inflict Hex. Then deal 9 dmg.
Alt de Fowl Friend II : Increase Feather Stack Limit by 1. Then activate FOWL FRIEND II (draw 1, max Feather, Activate x3).

passives.name: Nevermore Die Roll
passives.trigger: Upkeep de l'adversaire qui détient Nevermore
passives.text: 1 = gains Hex; 2 = Raveness may Activate Nevermore two times; 3 = Activate once; 4 = discards 1 of their choice; 5 = loses 1 CP, Raveness gains 1 CP; 6 = reduce dial to 0, then return Nevermore to the Raveness (no heal).

defense.name: Nothing More
defense.text: Defense Roll 5: On 2+ Talons, deal 2 dmg (ONCE, ruling user). On 2+ Wings, prevent 2 dmg (ONCE). On 2+ Raven Eyes, Activate Nevermore (ONCE). Nothing More II: deal 1 dmg PER Talon; the Wing/Eye pair thresholds unchanged.

cards.name: Cull!
cards.text: Instant Action. Change the value of the Nevermore Die Roll.

cards.name: Nevermore Attack!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Activate Nevermore. Then choose if the player that Nevermore is on Heals 2 or receives 2 dmg.

cards.name: Midnight Dreary!
cards.text: Main Phase Action. Roll 5 dice: Gain 1 x Feather per Wing. On Raven Eye, Activate Nevermore.

cards.name: Stone Beak!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action, Attack Modifier. Play only if Nevermore is on the target of your Attack. Add 1 dmg. This Attack becomes undefendable.

cards.name: Talon Strike!
cards.text: Roll Phase Action, Attack Modifier. Roll 5 dice: Add 1 x Talon dmg. Gain Feather.

cards.name: Chamber II
cards.text: CCCC: Activate Nevermore three times. Deal 7 undefendable dmg. Adds alt-ability AVIARY (CCC): Gain 4 Feather. Deal 2 undefendable dmg.

cards.name: Fowl Friend II
cards.text: BBB (ruling user): Draw 1. Gain max Feather. Activate Nevermore three times. Adds alt-ability BIRDS OF A FEATHER (BBBBB): Increase Feather Stack Limit by 1. Then activate FOWL FRIEND II.

cards.name: Raven Sight II
cards.text: AACC: Activate Nevermore two times. Deal 3 undefendable dmg.

cards.name: Peck II
cards.text: AAA: 6 dmg. AAAA: 7 dmg. AAAAA: 8 dmg. On 3-of-a-kind (#'s), Activate Nevermore.

cards.name: Beguile II
cards.text: Large Straight: Gain 3 Feather. Activate Nevermore two times. Deal 9 dmg. Adds alt-ability PLUCK (BBBCC): Inflict Hex. Then deal 9 dmg.

cards.name: Craven II
cards.text: Small Straight: Gain 2 Feather. Deal 9 dmg.

cards.name: Nothing More II
cards.text: Defense Roll 5: Deal 1 x Talon dmg. On 2 Wings, prevent 2 dmg (once). On 2 Raven Eyes, Activate Nevermore (once).

cards.name: Murder of Crows II
cards.text: AABBB: Deal 6 dmg & roll 5: Add 1 x Talon dmg. Gain 1 x Feather per Wing. On Raven Eye, Activate Nevermore.
